title: Integrations
description: Connect vendor accounts and slicers, and choose what they import and when.
loadError: Couldn't load integrations. Is the server running?
emptyBody: Connect a vendor account to import your printers and print history automatically.
noAdapters: No integrations are available in this version yet.
noTasks: An admin can let you sync or review an integration's data here.

errors.rate_limited: The vendor is limiting requests. It will retry later.
errors.unreachable: The vendor service can't be reached.
errors.code_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it and try again.
errors.blocked: The vendor's servers blocked the request. Wait a while and try again.
errors.api_changed: The vendor changed its service and this version can't read it any more. Check for an update of 3D Maker Suite.
errors.slice_failed: The slicer couldn't slice the file.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. See the server log for details.

card.disabledHint: Switched off: nothing is synced, imported or offered in the app. Tick Enabled to use it and change its settings.
card.unavailableHint: The slicer's config folder wasn't found on this server. If it's on another computer, mount it here and set Config folder to that path.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: Imported printers and prints stay. The credentials and the sync log are removed.

form.title: Add integration
form.error: Couldn't add the integration. Check the fields.

login.title: Sign in to {{name}}
login.passwordHint: Used once to sign in. Only the access token is stored, encrypted on this computer.
login.email_code: We sent a code to your email. Enter it to finish signing in.
login.totp: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.error: Couldn't sign in. Enter your email and password again.

newSpools.title: New spools
newSpools.hint: Spools that are not in the database yet.

weightHints.import: The spool is imported automatically, with the weight from the cloud.
weightHints.unset: The spool is imported automatically, without a weight.
weightHints.review: The spool is not imported: it waits for you to review it and fill in what you want.

openedAtHints.import: The spool is imported automatically, with the import date as its open date.
openedAtHints.unset: The spool is imported automatically, without an open date.
openedAtHints.review: The spool is not imported: it waits for you to review it and fill in what you want.

policies.manualHint: Runs only when you click Sync now.

summary.1MAt: Auto, every month on day {{day}} at {{time}}

at.hint: In the server's time zone. Any time: counted from the last sync.

editors.title: Editors
editors.hint: Admins always can. Editors never see the account or its settings.

policies.trackUsageOf: Take the filament of synced {{type}} from the spools
policies.trackUsageSpools: Take the remaining weight of synced spools from the vendor

scopeHints.all: Every row the source offers is added and kept up to date.
scopeHints.imported: Rows you already have are kept up to date. A new one is added only if you have its brand, so a new model of your printer brand still arrives, but nothing from brands you never imported. Start with "Review and import": filter the brand column, select all and import.

mergeHints.overwrite: A change at the source replaces what you have, your own edits included.
mergeHints.keepEdits: Fields you changed since the last sync stay as you left them; the other fields follow the source.
mergeHints.review: Nothing you have is changed by an automatic run. When the source changes a row, you get an alert and decide under "Review and import". A change you skip there doesn't come back until the source changes again.

policies.doubleTracking: Tracking usage from both prints and spools at the same time is not recommended: the same filament can be counted twice, or the vendor's estimate can overwrite the weight your prints took off.
policies.hint: Automatic runs import only what needs no decision from you. Anything else waits under "Review and import".

slicer.title: Slicer
slicer.configDirHint: Where the slicer keeps its presets. Leave empty to use the detected one: {{dir}}
slicer.pathHint: Full path to the slicer executable, used by "Open in slicer".

managed.notInstalledHint: Install the slicer below. The server downloads it from the vendor's GitHub releases and runs it itself.
managed.removeBody: Its program and profiles are deleted from this server. Slicing with it stops until you install it again. Imported presets stay.

errors.fetch_failed: Couldn't download {{version}}. Check the server's internet connection and try again.
errors.bad_digest: The download of {{version}} doesn't match its checksum, so it wasn't installed.
errors.unpack_failed: Couldn't unpack {{version}}. Is there enough free disk space?
errors.smoke_failed: {{version}} was downloaded but doesn't start on this server, so it wasn't installed.
errors.vcredist_missing: {{version}} needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64). Install it, then try again.

managed.size: Download: {{size}}. Unpacked it takes a little more, plus the old version until the new one works.
managed.noStable: No stable release can be installed on this server yet. Switch on pre-releases to see the others.
managed.noneForSystem: No release has a build for this server's system.
managed.releasesError: Couldn't read the releases from GitHub. Check the server's internet connection and try again later.
managed.licence: {{name}} is AGPL-3.0 software. 3D Maker Suite downloads the vendor's own release and doesn't change it.
managed.noProfiles: {{name}}'s download has no profiles this app can read, so this card can't import brands, printers or profiles. It slices with the settings saved in each 3MF file. To use other profiles, import them from a desktop install:

zipSteps.install: Install {{name}} on any computer and open it once.
zipSteps.folder: Open its config folder (Help → Show Configuration Folder), or find it yourself:
zipSteps.zip: Zip the system and user folders in it.

sync.periodHint: Opens the review with every print from that period, imported or not, so you pick what to import or update. Sync now and automatic runs always continue from the last sync.

syncError: Couldn’t sync. Check the integration in Settings.
